name: forge-sdlc
description: The AI-native SDLC loop as a team of agents over Matt Pocock's skills: wayfinder front door, intent, spec, plan, build, guardrail hooks. One effort, one folder, one pushed branch, one PR. Plus the run pane (/forge-pane: the frontier, the agents, where your context went, per-role routing and crew names from docs/agents/forge.md; the H button and /handoff-new hand the conversation off and start fresh; /forge, also /forge-sdlc:help, the help panel: the commands, the agents and how the loop runs) and the workbench mod: /focus-pane, /boards, a needs-you band above the prompt, /diff-pane, /side-chat, /morning, /crew.
